testimonials.name: Claire
testimonials.quote: I did a photoshoot with Maya for my yoga business, and it was a great experience! I was a bit nervous as I’m not super comfortable in front of a camera but Maya made it feel all so easy! With so much kindness, Maya kept reminding me: “Be you. Do what you do, what you teach. Take your time.” I felt I could relax and actually enjoy so much more without having to feel uncomfortable or nervous. The photos are amazing, I’m so happy and I definitely recommend Maya!

testimonials.name: Ava
testimonials.quote: My shoot with Maya was such a lovely experience. It felt like such an adventure and co-creation climbing trees, swimming and exploring different ways to get cool shots in nature. Maya has such a kind heart and she made me feel so calm and present and be able to really enjoy the experience. And the photos came out amazing!! I love them so much 🥰 would really recommend 💛
